title: Psionic program: some assets are abductees
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Psionic program: some assets are abductees, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In fact I was told we know for a fact >> that some of our assets are abductees.

plain: A filmmaker named Tim Alberino tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he was told some of the people used in a psionic programme, one using claimed psychic abilities, are people who say they were abducted by aliens. He quotes his source as saying "we know for a fact" that some of these assets are abductees. If true, it would mean the government draws on alien abduction experiences for its psychic work.
